source.title: Studentmållagsbibelen frå 1921, as shown by the CrossWire SWORD module NorSMB
source.attribution: Studentmållagsbibelen 1921 (Landsmål/Nynorsk), as shown by CrossWire module NorSMB; rights unverified - not for release.
source.provenance: Read on 2026-10-07 from the CrossWire passage-study pages for module NorSMB (1 John 1:8-9: https://crosswire.org/study/passagestudy.jsp?mod=NorSMB&key=1John+1%3A8-9 and John 3:16: https://crosswire.org/study/passagestudy.jsp?mod=NorSMB&key=John+3%3A16); nothing was downloaded. SINGLE-SOURCE READING: no second independent source for the 1921 text was found (the Åpen Bibel repository is the 1930 Bokmål text; bibel.no returned 403), so the wording is NOT confirmed and no scripture.verification record exists. The language is the 1921 Landsmål (hev, me, so, sanningi), not today's Nynorsk. Rights are unverified: CrossWire labels module NorSMB Public Domain; the translators' death years were not checked; this is not the 1938 translation. This sample MUST be replaced or verified before any release.
source.licenseNote: Rights unverified. CrossWire labels module NorSMB Public Domain; translators' death years unchecked. Do not ship until a person verifies.

review.notes: Unverified sample: wording read from one source only (CrossWire NorSMB). Landsmål of 1921, not the 2012 Nynorsk norm.

sentences.text: Dersom me segjer at me ikkje hev synd, so dårar me oss sjølve, og sanningi er ikkje i oss.
sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.

sentences.text: Dersom me sannar synderne våre, so er han trufast og rettferdig, so han forlet oss synderne og reinsar oss frå all urettferd.
sentences.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

sentences.text: For so elska Gud verdi at han gav Son sin, den einborne, so kvar den som trur på honom, ikkje skal verta fortapt, men hava ævelegt liv.
sentences.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
